svg.title: Waving and waving
svg.desc: Paper-cut scene with the sea on the left and the mountains on the right: two lines of children, waving, walk away from the middle, two by two. On the left, fifty children walk down to the beach behind Lạc Long Quân, who is small in the distance at the water's edge; on the right, fifty children climb a path up the green mountain behind Âu Cơ, small near the top.
